payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of the Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach in the context of offensive language detection using machine learning techniques.

claims.text: The Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach is used for offensive language detection in social media by combining various feature extraction methods and machine learning algorithms.
RKS was evaluated alongside other methods like Google sentence encoder and Fasttext for its effectiveness in detecting offensive content.
The RKS method achieved competitive results in the classification of offensive language compared to other machine learning algorithms.
